Summarise traffic volumes

Source: R/summarise_traffic.R
summarise_traffic.Rd

Calculate total traffic volume and the number of records for selected groups, such as monitoring sites, vehicle classes or months.

Usage

summarise_traffic(
  data,
  group_by = c("site", "vehicle_class"),
  date_range = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A traffic dataset containing the columns date and volume, along with the variables selected in group_by.

group_by

Character vector of variables used to group the results. Supported variables are date, month, site, heading, vehicle_class, speed_bin and classification_scheme. Defaults to c("site", "vehicle_class").

date_range

Optional Date vector of length two giving the inclusive start and end dates for the analysis.

Value

A data frame containing the selected grouping variables, total_volume and records, ordered by the grouping variables.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data("traffic_counts", package = "vicfreight")
summarise_traffic(
  traffic_counts,
  group_by = c("site", "vehicle_class")
)
} # }
